Decider's self-heal note should be amended retroactively.
h5_finding_summary.actual_root_cause: Integrity's Section 7h self-test ('if the scan flags >=1 entry, write a corresponding ISS in monitor/decisions/open-issues.json') does not specify clone-vs-FUSE read source. Haiku-model integrity uses cwd-relative reads, which default to FUSE for the workspace-relative paths it walks. Read from stale FUSE, modify in memory (append ISS-2519), write to clone (replacing fresh-pull content), push. PROP-045 protects workspace-sync's smart_copy and is sound; integrity has its own push path that bypasses smart_copy entirely.
